headline: Make every LED segment part of the scene
intro: Connect WLED lights to Home Assistant and shape their color, brightness, and effects alongside the rest of your home. Control strip segments separately, recall device presets and playlists, and build responsive lighting automations.
highlights: Control each WLED segment as its own light, with a master light for multi-segment strips
Choose device presets, playlists, palettes, and effects, and adjust segment speed and intensity
Receive real-time updates over WebSocket and manage stable firmware updates from Home Assistant

flow.title: Control one part of a strip
